role: Random block tick probe: over a raw region, each case rebuilds a small scene (its SCENES table: grass, mycelium, leaves, crops, sapling, cactus, reed, vine, stems, cocoa, nether wart, mushrooms, ice, snow, farmland, redstone ore and more) at a slot anchor, seeds the world Random and calls the anchor block's updateTick, recording every write, the 3x3 hash and the world Random state after the tick.
used_by: make -C oracle run CLASS=TickProbe (the generic {"cmd":"run","class":"TickProbe"} reflection dispatch in Oracle.java)
csrc/engine/randomtick.c and randomtick.h (cite it as the reference)
notes: Replaces the shared Math.random stream for the sweep the way DropsProbe does. Output manifest.json, scenes.bin, cases.bin, writes.bin, final.bin.gz. Scene list summarized, not enumerated. No oracle/src hook.
